newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon t-bill auction raises 470.8 bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon t-bill auction raises 470.8 bln pounds.

text.p: Lebanon's weekly treasury bill issue of July 17 raised 470.8 billion Lebanese pounds, according to finance ministry results issued on Monday.
The previous issue raised 284.5 billion pounds.
The issue posted a nominal surplus of subscription against maturity of 69.4 billion pounds. It raised the following amounts (in billion of pounds, previous week in brackets):

The central bank said six percent of all competitive bids, those made by Lebanese institutions, were accepted up to the discount rate and yield for three-month bills and 11 percent for the six-month bills.

It also restricted the acceptance of non-competitive bids, those made by private individuals and foreign investors, for the shorter-term bills, approving six percent up to the discount rate and yield for three-month bills and 11 percent for six-month bills.
All competitive and non-competitive bids were approved for one-year and two-year bills.
The Lebanese pound closed at 1,538.50 to the U.S. dollar on Monday from 1,538.75 a week earlier and 1,568 a year ago.
